title: Feelings
description: Feelings dealt at random in the embodied-voice exercises (data/embody.json). Each has a short scene to help imagine it.

id.description: Stable id starting with fe-. Never change or reuse one that has shipped.

name.description: The feeling, in lowercase, as it reads after "feeling" (for example "smug").

family.description: Rough group. The next feeling dealt comes from a different family where possible, so rerolls feel different.

scene.description: A one-line situation that brings the feeling on. Keep it light and kind; no harm to people or animals.
